_doc: atlas-gong-meetings-ingest sources. Copy to engine/atlas-gong-meetings-ingest/gong-sources.json. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
_doc_owner_emails: Required for the API and JSON paths. A Gong API key sees every call in the company, so a call is kept only when one of these addresses is a party to it, and the filter runs before anything is written. List every address the owner joins calls from.
_doc_api_base: Your tenant's API host, shown on Gong's API settings page next to the key. https://api.gong.io works for most tenants. Credentials never go in this file: set GONG_ACCESS_KEY and GONG_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET in the environment, or in ~/.config/atlas/gong-credentials.json with mode 600.
_doc_crm_context: true asks Gong for the CRM account linked to each call and writes its name to crm_accounts. Leave false if Gong has no CRM connected.
_doc_lookback_days: An incremental run re-reads this many days before the newest call it has seen, because Gong fills in the brief and outline after the call ends.
_doc_export_dirs: Folders of transcripts downloaded by hand from a call page (More actions, Download transcript). The only path for someone without an API key. A .md file with the same name as a transcript is attached as that call's notes; paste a Gong follow-up email or call spotlight there.
